toolSpec.name: extract_narrative_basic_info
toolSpec.description: Extract basic case information and narrative summary from complaint text

case_id.description: Unique case identifier from the complaint report

receipt_date.description: Date the complaint report was received

report_type.description: Type or source of report; NA for narratives

narrative.description: Full detailed narrative describing the complaint

narrative_summary.description: Concise (50-150 words) AI-generated summary capturing patient condition, product issues, severity, and outcome

primary_reporter.description: Name and address of the primary reporter; use NA if not available

patient_name.description: Name of the patient; NA if unavailable

physician_name.description: Name of the physician; NA if unavailable

product_details.description: Structured product information; NA if unavailable
